title: The too-busy life — Meera, 38, cortisol & the 10-minute walk
caption:
Too busy to be tired, still tired at 3pm? Ask your clinician about a morning cortisol test — it's drawn before 9am for a reason (Endocrine Society).
A 10-min walk after lunch blunts the crash (WHO: 150 min/wk).
Save this for your 3pm self.
What's your 3pm like? 3 words.
www.aiforheratx.org
#womenshealth #burnout #cortisol #workingmoms #perimenopause #mentalhealth #stressrelief

scenes.text: I'm *busy*, not tired. So why does 3pm flatten me every day?
scenes.suggest: → Ask for a *morning cortisol* test (Endocrine Society)

scenes.text: Two kids, a 7am standup, dinner at 8. She calls it busy. Her body calls it something else.
phrases: By 3pm her hands shake a little.
She's not lazy — she's running on empty.

scenes.text: Cortisol peaks 30-45 min after waking, so the test is drawn before 9am — timing is the whole point (Endocrine Society).
phrases: She asked for one blood draw.
Before 9am, because timing is the point.
Cortisol peaks 30-45 min after you wake up.
Normal or not, she finally had a number instead of a shrug.

phrases: 3. Eat protein at breakfast, not just chai.
